name: Upstash Vector Free
free_limit: One Free vector index: 10,000 queries/day and 10,000 updates/day; up to 1 GB vector metadata/data, 1,536 dimensions and 100 namespaces
watch_out: The Free index is limited to 200 million vector dimensions, 1 GB total data/metadata and 100 namespaces, with no uptime SLA. Entering a payment card upgrades that index to metered pay-as-you-go; do not confuse ongoing Free quotas with a paid or one-time trial.
